notes: Auto now upscales portrait phone videos as far as the same video sideways, so a 720p phone clip comes out in 4K. That takes about twice as long as the old 2× result. Edits that mix shapes now take the shape you used most, and no clip is shrunk. On the free version, an editor export with a colour look stops at 60 seconds with the mark, as the app and the website describe. A Pro copy now checks its license about once a week, and being offline never turns Pro off.
